scope: Labelled metadata controls for three native CI targets; not a population accuracy or recall estimate

alpine.basis: Alpine v3.22 main secdb records OpenSSL CVE-2025-9230 fixed at 3.5.4-r0. libcrypto3 is tested through its source origin openssl. Supplier metadata is a labelled synthetic control, not an installed-package attestation.

alma.basis: ALSA-2023:0946 publishes openssl-libs 3.0.1-47.el9_1 for this CVE. The predecessor is deliberately synthetic metadata immediately below the fixed EVR boundary; this does not assert that that exact predecessor binary was published. Binary epoch is 1; SOURCERPM has no observed source epoch.

rocky.basis: RLSA-2023:0946 and the RESF OSV feed publish fixed EVR 1:3.0.1-47.el9_1 for this CVE. The predecessor is deliberately synthetic metadata immediately below the fixed EVR boundary; this does not assert that that exact predecessor binary was published. Binary epoch is 1; SOURCERPM has no observed source epoch.
